name: statz-nba
description: Look up NBA statistics and Statz model projections: season leaders, player profiles and game logs, game-by-game team grids, standings, injuries, and projected scores for any night's games.

interface.longDescription:
Look up NBA statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See the season leaders for players (points, rebounds, assists, threes, steals, blocks, shooting percentages and more), by team or position, and for teams.
- Check a player's season averages and league ranks, and their full game log.
- Get a team's record, standing, stat ranks and recent form.
- See every player's points, rebounds, assists or another box-score stat across a team's last 5 to 15 games, with minutes played.
- See any night's games with the Statz model's projected score and win probability, and player projections for points, rebounds, assists and more.
- Check conference standings and current injury reports.

Answers come with a ranked board and links to the full stats on statz.ai. Open Statz NBA from the sidebar to browse the boards.

Statz NBA provides statistics and projections only: no odds and no betting services.
capabilities: Season stat leaders for players and teams
Projected scores for any night's games
defaultPrompt: Who are the top scorers in the NBA this season?
Show every Knicks player's points game by game.

positive.description: Season leaders for one player stat.
positive.prompt: Who are the top scorers in the NBA this season?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of the top 10 scorers with their teams and points per game, highest first, and a link to the full leaderboard on statz.ai.

positive.prompt: Show me Nikola Jokic's last 10 games.
positive.expected_behavior: A board of Jokic's last 10 games with opponent, result, points, rebounds, assists and minutes, plus his averages over those games.

positive.prompt: Show me the Western Conference standings.
positive.expected_behavior: A table of the 15 Western Conference teams with wins, losses and win percentage, in standings order.

positive.description: Today's games with the Statz model's projections.
positive.prompt: What are Statz's projected scores for today's NBA games?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of today's games with tip-off time, the Statz projected score and each team's win probability. The reply says these are model projections. On a day with no games it says so.

positive.description: Every player on a team, game by game, in one stat.
positive.prompt: Show every Knicks player's points over their last 10 games.
positive.expected_behavior: A grid with one row per Knicks player and one column per game (date, opponent, result), showing points and minutes played, each player's average, and a team total row.

negative.description: Asks for betting odds. Statz NBA carries no prices, bookmakers or betting links, so none should be returned. At most the model offers Statz's own statistics or projections and says they are not betting odds.
negative.prompt: What are the odds on the Celtics winning tonight?

negative.description: Asks to place a bet. Every tool is read-only and none can place a bet or take any action.
negative.prompt: Bet $50 on LeBron James to score over 25 points tonight.

negative.description: Not an NBA statistics question, so no Statz NBA tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Book me two tickets to the next Lakers home game.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: season stat leaders for players and teams, player profiles and game logs, game-by-game team grids, team profiles, standings, games with projected scores, player projections, injuries and a sidebar app.
